messages:
Acme Integrations: hey @support — since ~14:03 UTC we're seeing a bunch of requests routed to eu-edge with 504/latency spikes. Our SDK is sending client_region="us-west" but traces show X-Client-Region: "" on the request headers. Any idea why we'd be routed to EU?

Support Bot: created ticket INC-2026-1287 and assigned to Alex Kim :white_check_mark:

Alex Kim: hi — sorry about the interruption. can you paste one full failing request (headers + request id) and the approximate time? also whether you pass region as a query param, header, or sdk flag. sometimes proxies rewrite things.

Acme Integrations: here's a minimal repro from our infra at 14:03:22 UTC (sanitized):

```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "X-Client-Region:" "" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

Response headers include: ``Via: eu-edge-01``, status 504, and server logs show router picked region=eu. Request-id: r-0a1b2c3d.

Emma Li: thanks. that blank header is the smoking gun — if X-Client-Region header is present but empty some proxies/setups end up keeping the header and our edge routing checks header existence before value, which in edge cases falls back to geo-ip lookups (for you that maps to eu). quick workaround: remove the header entirely or set it explicitly to us-west.

Jordan (SRE): to add context — we recently tightened header precedence: query param > header > ip-geo. the bug is that the router was checking header presence with something like `if (req.headers['x-client-region'])` which treats `""` as falsy in JS, but an upstream proxy that rewrites empty headers can leave an empty header token which still counts as present in our lower-level header map. result: existence check returns true while the value is empty-string at a different layer, causing inconsistent behavior.

Acme Integrations: aha — our nginx was doing `proxy_set_header X-Client-Region $http_x_client_region;` which forwards an empty header if incoming is absent. changing to: 

```nginx
# only set when upstream header is present
if ($http_x_client_region) {
  proxy_set_header X-Client-Region $http_x_client_region;
}
```

will remove the blank header. we'll patch and deploy in a few mins.

Alex Kim: thanks for the repro and nginx snippet — super helpful. we'll also deploy a small defensive change on the router: treat empty-string and purely whitespace header values as absent when computing routing precedence. i'll push to staging now and then to prod after verification (ENG-4897). ETA ~24 hours for prod rollout, but staging patch is immediate.

Emma Li: as a short-term customer-facing mitigation, you can set the SDK option or environment var to force the region header: `REGION_OVERRIDE=us-west` or call the api with `?client_region=us-west` which will beat the header.

Jordan (SRE): logged ENG-4897 and linked INC-2026-1287. also added a watch to oncall for the next 48h in case other customers hit similar proxy behavior.

Acme Integrations: patch deployed on our side. i confirm requests now come into us-west edge and latency is back to normal. will keep monitoring and shout if we see more. thanks team. :pray:

Support Bot: INC-2026-1287 status updated -> linked to ENG-4897. closing on customer side per confirmation; re-open if anything else shows up
